name: free-coding-agent-ui
description: TypeScript web UI for the Coding Agent

scripts.verify-client: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const code = fs.readFileSync('dist/client/app.js', 'utf8'); const stripped = code.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\/|\/\/.*/g, ''); if (/Object\.defineProperty\(\s*exports/.test(stripped) || /^\s*exports\.[a-zA-Z0-9_$]+\s*=/m.test(stripped) || /^module\.exports\s*=/m.test(stripped) || /\bexports\.__esModule\b/.test(stripped)) { console.error('ERROR: CommonJS export assignment found in client bundle!'); process.exit(1); } else { console.log('Client bundle verification passed: valid ESM bundle with no CommonJS export leaks.'); }"
